speaker: Sheldon
text: Penny with a new guy? It wasn't awkward.

speaker: Leonard
text: Trey, awkward. It wasn't fun.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Besides, what's the big deal? We dated, we, we stopped dating, and now we're both moving on.

speaker: Leonard
text: By moving on, you mean she's going out with other men, and you spend the afternoon making 15th century soap at Woolworths?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That was not 15th century soap. My God, those people need to learn you can't just put ye olde in front of anything you want and expect to get away with it. Can we please just go in? My chainmail's stuck in my underwear.

speaker: Leonard
text: You're wearing modern underwear.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Relatively modern.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why, what are you wearing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I fashioned historically accurate undergarments out of linen.

speaker: Leonard
text: You went out and bought linen?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Don't be silly. I borrowed one of your pillowcases. Borrowed?

speaker: Sheldon
text: You know what? I'm happy that Penny's moving on. Gives me the freedom to move on myself.

speaker: Leonard
text: Are you saying that you've been holding back?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Of course. Out of respect.

speaker: Leonard
text: So, how do you explain the ten years before Penny?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Who are you respecting then?

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, I've dated plenty of women. There was, uh, Joyce Kim, Leslie Winkle.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Notify the editors of the Oxford English Dictionary the word plenty has been redefined to mean two.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, what about that girl last year at Comic-Con? Why not?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Doesn't count. What happens in costume at Comic-Con stays at Comic-Con.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm only saying that because of what happened to you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What happened to you? Nothing happened to me.

speaker: Leonard
text: It wasn't your fault, Raj. He was dressed as a green Orion slave girl.

speaker: Sheldon
text: How did we get on me? We were mocking Leonard for not moving on. Dude, you have totally not moved on.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes, I have. It's just a matter of actually making a date with someone. Well, there's Joyce Kim, but, She defected back to North Korea, so, a little geographically undesirable.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Like who?

speaker: Sheldon
text: What about Leslie Winkle?

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, no. Her research methodology is sloppy, she's unjustifiably arrogant about loop quantum gravity, and to make matters worse, she's often mean to me.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I think she's smoking hot. I'd hit that.

speaker: Leonard
text: You hit particulate soil on a colloidal suspension. Mud. Look, I like Leslie, but she's not interested in dating as much as using men as tools for stress release.

speaker: Sheldon
text: So, be a tool. Go get yourself a little rebound stress release.

speaker: Leonard
text: Technically, it would only be rebound if he and Penny had actually engaged in physical intercourse.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You mean like you and Richard the slave girl?

speaker: Leonard
text: I bought him dinner, and we kissed once. That was it. And he told me his name was Kimberly.
